---
title: "Sampling Distribution Explorer — SAP Customer ROE"
---

This app accompanies the [sampling-distribution walkthrough](inference_01_sampling-distributions.qmd#sec-app-walkthrough) in the chapter on sampling distributions. It simulates the population of 30,000 ROE values described there, so you can redraw samples at will. Each draw records the mean ROE of $n$ companies — and $n$ is yours to change, unlike the study's fixed 81. The means accumulate into the sampling distribution of the sample mean. Checkboxes add the normal approximation and a 95% confidence interval whose coverage you can track across thousands of samples.

The app runs in your browser and takes a few moments to start.

[Open the sampling distribution explorer](https://jaredsmurray.github.io/stats-webapps/sap_sampling.html){target="_blank"}
